about.title: About
about.description: Juan Serrano Studio is a Southern California photography practice working across sports, portraiture, editorial, weddings, and events.
about.lead: Juan Serrano Studio photographs people, events, and the places where their stories unfold.
body: The practice works across sports, portraiture, editorial commissions, weddings, and events. Each assignment begins by understanding what needs to be photographed and how the images will be used.

On the day, the approach is prepared and observant: give clear direction when it helps, then make space for real moments to happen. Scope, delivery, usage, and pricing are agreed in writing before a booking is confirmed.
The studio is based in Southern California and is available for assignments on location. Specific city, experience details, and client credits can be added when confirmed.
approach: Prepared for the brief and location
Attentive without making the camera the center of the day
Clear about deliverables, usage, and cost before booking
